in_sanskrit.name: Jagdis
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Conqueror of the World
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Jagdis एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Jagat (world) + Dis (conqueror) = Jagdis. This name is derived from the Sanskrit language and is rooted in Hindu mythology. Jagdis is a powerful name, signifying one who has the strength and courage to conquer all aspects of life.
